import pandas as pd, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, ConfusionMatrixDisplay
df = pd.read_csv('clean.csv')
train, test = train_test_split(df, test_size=0.2, random_state=110)
train.to_csv('train.csv', index=False); test.to_csv('test.csv', index=False)
m = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, random_state=0)
m.fit(train.drop(columns='outcome'), train.outcome)
acc = accuracy_score(test.outcome, m.predict(test.drop(columns='outcome')))
ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_estimator(m, test.drop(columns='outcome'), test.outcome); plt.savefig('live/02_confusion.png')
h = pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
pd.DataFrame({'prediction': m.predict(h)}).to_csv('predictions.csv', index=False)
json.dump({'test_accuracy': acc, 'model': 'random forest', 'notes': ''}, open('report.json', 'w'))
print(acc)
